newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil hopes to complete CVRD sale this year.
newsitem.headline: Brazil hopes to complete CVRD sale this year.

text.p: The Brazilian government hopes to complete a domestic and international public offering of shares in mining group Companhia do Vale Rio Doce (CVRD) this year, the last and final stage of the sell-off, an official said.
"We think within nine months would be reasonable but our aim is to carry out the global offer this year," said Jose Pio Borges, privatisation director of the National Development Bank (BNDES).
Borges was speaking at a seminar to explain the tender details of the CVRD privatisation, published in the government's Official Journal Thursday.
The sale, expected to be Latin America's biggest privatisation to date, will start on April 29 with an initial sell-off of 45 percent of voting shares.
This will be followed "the next day or within a few days" by an offer of 5.1 percent of the company's capital to employees, Borges said.
The rest of the government's 51 percent stake in CVRD's capital will then be floated globally.
